verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is a robotics middleware framework. Its ecosystem could plausibly add AI or agent integrations, so the MCP-client axis is not a clear category error. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows any ability to connect to MCP servers or use their tools. Its documented features cover pub/sub, services, actions, QoS, security, the CLI and bags, none of which is an MCP client capability.
